quote: Persephone (aka Kore) was the Greek goddess of agriculture and vegetation, especially grain, and the wife of Hades, the ruler of the Underworld.

statement.id: Persephone adalah dewi pertanian dan tumbuhan Yunani serta istri Hades.
statement.en: Persephone is a Greek goddess of agriculture and vegetation and wife of Hades.

quote: In this guise she is most often referred to as Kore, signifying both 'daughter' and 'maiden'.
locator: What are the Different Names of Persephone?

statement.id: Nama Kore berarti anak perempuan dan gadis.
statement.en: Kore means daughter and maiden.

quote: In Greek mythology, the goddess, as wife of Hades, is the Queen of the Underworld and takes her other name, Persephone.
locator: What are the Different Names of Persephone?

statement.id: Sebagai istri Hades, Persephone adalah ratu dunia bawah.
statement.en: As Hades's wife, Persephone is queen of the underworld.

quote: Hades abducted Persephone while she was picking flowers with her companions in a meadow and carried her off to the Underworld

statement.id: Hades menculik Persephone saat ia memetik bunga dan membawanya ke dunia bawah.
statement.en: Hades abducted Persephone while she picked flowers and took her to the underworld.

quote: There the wrath of the distressed mother caused a complete failure of the crops, prompting Zeus to order his brother Hades to return the girl.

statement.id: Kesedihan Demeter menyebabkan gagal panen sehingga Zeus meminta Hades mengembalikan Persephone.
statement.en: Demeter's grief caused crop failure, prompting Zeus to demand Persephone's return.

quote: He cunningly tricked Persephone into eating some pomegranate seeds before leaving, thus condemning her to spend part of the year in the Underworld as his wife and the rest among the living with Demeter

statement.id: Karena biji delima, Persephone harus menghabiskan sebagian tahun di dunia bawah dan sisanya bersama Demeter.
statement.en: Pomegranate seeds obliged Persephone to spend part of the year below and the rest with Demeter.

quote: The story of Demeter, Hades and Persephone was perhaps symbolic of the changing seasons and the perennial change from life to death, to life once more
locator: What is the Significance of the Hades-Persephone Myth?

statement.id: Kisah ini dapat melambangkan pergantian musim dan daur kehidupan.
statement.en: The story may symbolize seasonal change and life's cycle.

quote: Persephone was an important element of the Eleusinian Mysteries and the Thesmophoria festival and so the goddess was worshipped throughout the Greek world.

statement.id: Persephone terkait dengan Misteri Eleusis dan perayaan Thesmophoria.
statement.en: Persephone was linked to the Eleusinian Mysteries and Thesmophoria.

quote: At the right is Persephone, her daughter and the wife of Hades, the god of the underworld.

statement.id: Relief Eleusis menggambarkan Persephone di sisi kanan sebagai putri Demeter.
statement.en: The Eleusinian relief depicts Persephone on the right as Demeter's daughter.

quote: Hades, god of the Underworld, fell in love with beautiful Persephone when he saw her picking flowers one day in a meadow. The god then carried her off in his chariot to live with him in the dark Underworld.

statement.id: Hades, dewa dunia bawah, jatuh cinta pada Persephone yang cantik ketika melihatnya memetik bunga di padang rumput, lalu membawanya dengan kereta ke dunia bawah yang gelap.
statement.en: Hades, god of the Underworld, fell in love with the beautiful Persephone when he saw her picking flowers in a meadow, then carried her off in his chariot to the dark Underworld.

quote: In some accounts, Zeus had given his consent to the abduction, the location of the crime being traditionally placed in either Sicily (famed for its fertility) or Asia.

statement.id: Dalam sebagian versi Zeus menyetujui penculikan itu, dan lokasinya secara tradisional ditempatkan di Sisilia (termasyhur kesuburannya) atau Asia.
statement.en: In some accounts Zeus had consented to the abduction, and the location is traditionally placed in either Sicily (famed for its fertility) or Asia.

quote: Meanwhile, Demeter searched the earth for her lost divine daughter and though Helios (or Hermes) told her of her daughter's fate, she, nevertheless, continued her wanderings until she finally arrived at Eleusis.

statement.id: Demeter mencari putrinya ke seluruh bumi; meski Helios (atau Hermes) memberitahunya nasib putrinya, ia terus berkelana hingga tiba di Eleusis.
statement.en: Demeter searched the earth for her lost daughter; though Helios (or Hermes) told her her daughter's fate, she kept wandering until she arrived at Eleusis.

quote: Once the temple was completed, Demeter withdrew from the world and lived inside it; at the same time, she created a great drought to convince the other gods to release Persephone from Hades. As the drought claimed ever more victims, Zeus finally sent Hermes to persuade Hades to release his ill-gotten bride.

statement.id: Setelah kuil selesai, Demeter menarik diri dan tinggal di dalamnya sambil menciptakan kekeringan besar agar dewa-dewa lain melepaskan Persephone; ketika korban kekeringan bertambah, Zeus mengutus Hermes membujuk Hades.
statement.en: Once the temple was finished, Demeter withdrew into it and created a great drought to convince the other gods to release Persephone; as the drought claimed more victims, Zeus sent Hermes to persuade Hades to release her.

quote: Before giving her up though, the wily Hades put a pomegranate kernel in the girl's mouth, knowing its divine taste would compel her to return to him.

statement.id: Sebelum melepasnya, Hades yang licik menaruh sebutir biji delima di mulut Persephone karena tahu rasa ilahinya akan memaksanya kembali.
statement.en: Before giving her up, the wily Hades put a pomegranate kernel in her mouth, knowing its divine taste would compel her to return to him.

quote: Finally, as a compromise, it was decided that Persephone would be released but that she would have to return to Hades for one-third of the year (or in other accounts one-half).

statement.id: Sebagai kompromi, diputuskan Persephone dilepas tetapi harus kembali kepada Hades selama sepertiga tahun (atau separuh tahun dalam versi lain).
statement.en: As a compromise, it was decided Persephone would be released but must return to Hades for one-third of the year (or one-half in other accounts).

quote: Another interpretation of the Persephone myth may be that it represents when the Greeks stored their grain underground for part of the year in order to protect it from summer heat.
locator: What is the Significance of the Hades-Persephone Myth?

statement.id: Tafsiran lain: mitos itu mungkin menggambarkan saat orang Yunani menyimpan gandum di bawah tanah selama sebagian tahun untuk melindunginya dari panas musim panas.
statement.en: Another interpretation is that the myth represents the Greeks storing their grain underground for part of the year to protect it from summer heat.

quote: The cult of Persephone in the Greek religion was especially strong in Sicily and southern Italy, and besides the Eleusinian Mysteries at Eleusis there were sanctuaries to the goddess across the Greek world, most notably at Locri Epizephyrii, Mantinea, Megalopolis, and Sparta.

statement.id: Kultus Persephone dalam agama Yunani sangat kuat di Sisilia dan Italia selatan; selain Misteri Eleusis di Eleusis, ada tempat suci untuknya di seluruh dunia Yunani, terutama di Locri Epizephyrii, Mantinea, Megalopolis, dan Sparta.
statement.en: Persephone's cult was especially strong in Sicily and southern Italy; besides the Eleusinian Mysteries at Eleusis there were sanctuaries across the Greek world, notably at Locri Epizephyrii, Mantinea, Megalopolis and Sparta.

quote: The Thesmophoria was a Greek-wide celebration of the goddess and her mother. Exclusive to women, it was held annually before the sowing period when sacrifices were made and putrefied pig's remains were mixed with the seeds.

statement.id: Thesmophoria adalah perayaan seluruh Yunani untuk sang dewi dan ibunya; khusus perempuan, diadakan tiap tahun sebelum masa menabur, dengan kurban dan sisa babi yang membusuk dicampur ke benih.
statement.en: The Thesmophoria was a Greek-wide celebration of the goddess and her mother, exclusive to women and held annually before sowing, when sacrifices were made and putrefied pig remains were mixed with the seeds.

quote: Persephone, in her guise as Queen of the Underworld, was often appealed to in curse tablets and on the inscribed gold leaves buried with the dead followers of Orphism which gave instructions on how to conduct themselves in the after-life.

statement.id: Sebagai Ratu Dunia Bawah, Persephone sering dimohon dalam tablet kutukan dan pada lembaran emas bertulis yang dikubur bersama pengikut Orfisme yang meninggal.
statement.en: As Queen of the Underworld, Persephone was often appealed to in curse tablets and on inscribed gold leaves buried with dead followers of Orphism.

quote: In this guise, she was seen as a protectress in the after-life, although Hesiod repeatedly describes her as 'dread Persephone' in his Theogony.
locator: What are the Different Names of Persephone?

statement.id: Dalam peran itu ia dipandang sebagai pelindung di alam baka, meski Hesiodos berulang kali menyebutnya "Persephone yang menakutkan" dalam Theogony.
statement.en: In that guise she was seen as a protectress in the after-life, although Hesiod repeatedly calls her "dread Persephone" in his Theogony.

quote: Persephone rarely appears in art before the 6th century BCE, and then she is usually shown with Demeter; often both wear crowns and hold a torch, sceptre, or stalks of grain.
locator: How is Persephone Represented in Art?

statement.id: Persephone jarang muncul dalam seni sebelum abad ke-6 SM, dan kemudian biasanya ditampilkan bersama Demeter; keduanya sering bermahkota dan memegang obor, tongkat kerajaan, atau tangkai gandum.
statement.en: Persephone rarely appears in art before the 6th century BCE, then is usually shown with Demeter; both often wear crowns and hold a torch, sceptre or stalks of grain.

quote: In various other myths, Persephone is the mother of Dionysos (with Zeus, who is also her father) - although Semele is the more usual candidate - and squabbles with Aphrodite for the attentions of devilishly handsome Adonis, the two settling to share the famous lover in split shifts.
locator: What are the Different Names of Persephone?

statement.id: Dalam beberapa mitos lain Persephone ibu Dionysos (dengan Zeus, yang juga ayahnya), meski Semele kandidat yang lebih lazim, dan ia bersaing dengan Aphrodite memperebutkan Adonis hingga keduanya sepakat berbagi sang kekasih bergiliran.
statement.en: In various other myths Persephone is the mother of Dionysos (by Zeus, who is also her father), though Semele is the more usual candidate, and she squabbles with Aphrodite over Adonis, the two agreeing to share the lover in turns.

quote: A famous relief slab from Eleusis depicts Demeter and Persephone (holding a torch) either side of Triptolemos; it dates to the 5th century BCE.
locator: How is Persephone Represented in Art?

statement.id: Sebuah lempeng relief terkenal dari Eleusis menampilkan Demeter dan Persephone (memegang obor) di kedua sisi Triptolemos; berasal dari abad ke-5 SM.
statement.en: A famous relief slab from Eleusis shows Demeter and Persephone (holding a torch) on either side of Triptolemos; it dates to the 5th century BCE.

quote: In other versions of the myth, Persephone could have been released if she had not eaten anything in the underworld during her captivity, but at the last moment, Hades gave her a pomegranate seed.

statement.id: Dalam versi lain Persephone bisa dibebaskan seandainya ia tidak makan apa pun di dunia bawah, tetapi pada detik terakhir Hades memberinya sebutir biji delima.
statement.en: In other versions Persephone could have been released had she eaten nothing in the underworld, but at the last moment Hades gave her a pomegranate seed.

quote: and the girl was amazed and reached out with both hands to take the lovely toy; but the wide-pathed earth yawned there in the plain of Nysa, and the lord, Host of Many, with his immortal horses sprang out upon her

statement.id: Menurut Himne Homerik untuk Demeter, gadis itu takjub dan mengulurkan kedua tangan untuk mengambil bunga itu; lalu bumi menganga di dataran Nysa dan Sang Tuan Banyak Tamu melompat keluar dengan kuda-kuda abadinya.
statement.en: In the Homeric Hymn to Demeter the girl was amazed and reached out with both hands for the lovely flower; then the earth yawned in the plain of Nysa and the lord, Host of Many, sprang out with his immortal horses.

quote: which Earth made to grow at the will of Zeus and to please the Host of Many, to be a snare for the bloom-like girl

statement.id: Bunga narsis itu ditumbuhkan Bumi atas kehendak Zeus dan untuk menyenangkan Sang Tuan Banyak Tamu, sebagai jerat bagi gadis yang segar bagai bunga.
statement.en: The narcissus was made to grow by Earth at the will of Zeus and to please the Host of Many, as a snare for the bloom-like girl.

quote: only tender-hearted Hecate, bright-coiffed, the daughter of Persaeus, heard the girl from her cave, and the lord Helios, Hyperion's bright son

statement.id: Hanya Hecate yang berhati lembut, putri Persaeus, mendengar teriakan gadis itu dari guanya, begitu pula tuan Helios, putra Hyperion yang cemerlang.
statement.en: Only tender-hearted Hecate, daughter of Persaeus, heard the girl from her cave, and the lord Helios, Hyperion's bright son.

quote: And while you are here, you shall rule all that lives and moves and shall have the greatest rights among the deathless gods: those who defraud you and do not appease your power with offerings, reverently performing rites and paying fit gifts, shall be punished for evermore.

statement.id: Dalam Himne Homerik, Hades berkata kepada Persephone bahwa selama di sana ia akan memerintah semua yang hidup dan bergerak dan memiliki hak terbesar di antara para dewa; mereka yang menipunya dan tidak menenangkan kuasanya dengan persembahan akan dihukum selamanya.
statement.en: In the Homeric Hymn Hades tells Persephone that while she is there she shall rule all that lives and moves and have the greatest rights among the gods; those who defraud her and do not appease her power with offerings shall be punished for evermore.

quote: But he on his part secretly gave her sweet pomegranate seed to eat, taking care for himself that she might not remain continually with grave, dark-robed Demeter.

statement.id: Hades diam-diam memberinya biji delima manis untuk dimakan agar ia tidak terus-menerus tinggal bersama Demeter.
statement.en: Hades secretly gave her sweet pomegranate seed to eat, taking care that she might not remain continually with Demeter.

quote: if you have tasted food, you must go back again beneath the secret places of the earth, there to dwell a third part of the seasons every year: yet for the two parts you shall be with me and the other deathless gods.

statement.id: Demeter berkata: jika Persephone telah mencicipi makanan, ia harus kembali ke bawah bumi dan tinggal di sana sepertiga musim setiap tahun, sedangkan dua bagian lainnya ia bersama Demeter dan para dewa.
statement.en: Demeter says that if Persephone has tasted food she must go back beneath the earth to dwell a third part of the seasons every year, and for the other two parts be with her and the other gods.

quote: But when the earth shall bloom with the fragrant flowers of spring in every kind, then from the realm of darkness and gloom thou shalt come up once more to be a wonder for gods and mortal men.

statement.id: Ketika bumi mekar dengan bunga-bunga musim semi yang harum, Persephone akan naik lagi dari alam gelap menjadi keajaiban bagi dewa dan manusia.
statement.en: When the earth blooms with the fragrant flowers of spring, Persephone shall come up once more from the realm of darkness to be a wonder for gods and mortals.

quote: from that time the lady Hecate was minister and companion to Persephone.

statement.id: Sejak saat itu Hecate menjadi pelayan dan pendamping Persephone.
statement.en: From that time Hecate was minister and companion to Persephone.

quote: Ancient Greek: Περσεφόνη ) is the daughter of Zeus and Demeter. She became the queen of the underworld after her abduction by her uncle Hades, the king of the underworld, who later took her into marriage.

statement.id: Persephone (Περσεφόνη dalam bahasa Yunani Kuno) adalah putri Zeus dan Demeter; ia menjadi ratu dunia bawah setelah diculik pamannya, Hades, raja dunia bawah, yang kemudian menikahinya.
statement.en: Persephone (Περσεφόνη in Ancient Greek) is the daughter of Zeus and Demeter; she became queen of the underworld after her abduction by her uncle Hades, king of the underworld, who later took her into marriage.

quote: The myth of her abduction, her sojourn in the underworld, and her cyclical return to the surface represents her functions as the embodiment of spring and the personification of vegetation, especially grain crops

statement.id: Mitos penculikan, masa tinggalnya di dunia bawah, dan kembalinya yang berulang ke permukaan mewakili fungsinya sebagai perwujudan musim semi dan personifikasi tumbuhan, terutama tanaman biji-bijian.
statement.en: The myth of her abduction, sojourn in the underworld and cyclical return to the surface represents her functions as embodiment of spring and personification of vegetation, especially grain crops.

quote: In Classical Greek art, Persephone is invariably portrayed robed, often carrying a sheaf of grain. She may appear as a mystical divinity with a sceptre and a little box, but she was mostly represented in the process of being carried off by Hades.

statement.id: Dalam seni Yunani Klasik, Persephone selalu digambarkan berjubah, sering membawa seikat gandum; ia dapat tampil sebagai dewi mistik dengan tongkat dan kotak kecil, tetapi paling sering ditampilkan saat dibawa pergi Hades.
statement.en: In Classical Greek art Persephone is invariably robed, often carrying a sheaf of grain; she may appear as a mystical divinity with a sceptre and a little box, but was mostly shown being carried off by Hades.

quote: Persephone, as a vegetation goddess, and her mother Demeter were the central figures of the Eleusinian Mysteries, which promised the initiated a happy afterlife.

statement.id: Persephone sebagai dewi tumbuhan dan ibunya, Demeter, adalah tokoh sentral Misteri Eleusis yang menjanjikan akhirat bahagia bagi para penganutnya.
statement.en: Persephone as a vegetation goddess and her mother Demeter were the central figures of the Eleusinian Mysteries, which promised initiates a happy afterlife.

quote: She is a goddess of marriage and childbirth in the region of the city of Epizephyrian Locris, in modern Calabria (southern Italy).

statement.id: Di wilayah kota Locris Epizephyria, di Calabria modern (Italia selatan), ia adalah dewi pernikahan dan kelahiran.
statement.en: In the region of the city of Epizephyrian Locris, in modern Calabria (southern Italy), she is a goddess of marriage and childbirth.

quote: In Latin, her name is rendered Proserpina. She was identified by the Romans as Libera, an Italic goddess who was conflated with Proserpina.

statement.id: Dalam bahasa Latin namanya menjadi Proserpina; orang Romawi mengidentifikasinya sebagai Libera, dewi Italik yang dipadukan dengan Proserpina.
statement.en: In Latin her name is rendered Proserpina; the Romans identified her as Libera, an Italic goddess conflated with Proserpina.

quote: The etymology of the word "Persephone" is obscure. ... pherein phonon, "to bring (or cause) death".

statement.id: Asal kata "Persephone" tidak jelas; etimologi rakyat yang populer mengaitkannya dengan pherein phonon, "membawa (atau menyebabkan) kematian".
statement.en: The etymology of "Persephone" is obscure; a popular folk etymology links it to pherein phonon, "to bring (or cause) death".

quote: Günther Zuntz considers "Persephone" and "Kore" as distinct deities and writes that "no farmer prayed for corn to Persephone; no mourner thought of the dead as being with Kore." Ancient Greek writers were, however, not as consistent as Zuntz claims.

statement.id: Günther Zuntz menganggap "Persephone" dan "Kore" dewi yang berbeda ("tak ada petani memohon gandum kepada Persephone; tak ada orang berduka membayangkan yang mati bersama Kore"), tetapi para penulis Yunani kuno tidak sekonsisten klaimnya.
statement.en: Günther Zuntz considers "Persephone" and "Kore" distinct deities ("no farmer prayed for corn to Persephone; no mourner thought of the dead as being with Kore"), but ancient Greek writers were not as consistent as he claims.

quote: Myths similar to Persephone's descent and return to earth also appear in the cults of male gods, including Attis, Adonis, and Osiris, and in Minoan Crete.

statement.id: Mitos serupa turunnya Persephone dan kembalinya ke bumi juga muncul dalam kultus dewa-dewa laki-laki, termasuk Attis, Adonis, dan Osiris, serta di Kreta Minoa.
statement.en: Myths similar to Persephone's descent and return also appear in the cults of male gods, including Attis, Adonis and Osiris, and in Minoan Crete.

quote: The epithets of Persephone reveal her double function as chthonic and vegetation goddess.

statement.id: Julukan Persephone menunjukkan fungsi gandanya sebagai dewi kekuatan bawah tanah (khthonik) dan dewi tumbuhan.
statement.en: Persephone's epithets reveal her double function as chthonic and vegetation goddess.

quote: According to a recent hypothesis advanced by Rudolf Wachter ... The combined sense would therefore be "she who beats the ears of corn", i.e., a "thresher of grain"

statement.id: Menurut hipotesis Rudolf Wachter, makna gabungan namanya adalah "ia yang memukul bulir gandum", yaitu "perontok gandum".
statement.en: According to a hypothesis by Rudolf Wachter, the combined sense of the name would be "she who beats the ears of corn", i.e. a "thresher of grain".

quote: In cult, she was often referred to as Kore

statement.id: Dalam kultus ia sering disebut Kore.
statement.en: In cult she was often referred to as Kore.
